hebrewText: קָרְס֤וּ כָֽרְעוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ מַלֵּ֣ט מַשָּׂ֑א וְ/נַפְשָׁ֖/ם בַּ/שְּׁבִ֥י הָלָֽכָה

tokens.bdb: to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate
tokens.kjv: bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, [idiom] very.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to bend the knee; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to bend the knee; by implication
tokens.explanation: to bend the knee; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to bend the knee; by implication

tokens.kjv: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
tokens.kjv: be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.

tokens.bdb: properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks
tokens.kjv: deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly adoom, especially singing; mental, desire
tokens.kjv: burden, carry away, prophecy, [idiom] they set, song, tribute.

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.
tokens.explanation: nefesh — alma, ser vivo, vida, pessoa, desejo interior

tokens.bdb: exiled; captured; as noun, exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively); by extension, booty
tokens.kjv: captive(-ity), prisoners, [idiom] take away, that was taken.

tokens.bdb: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, [phrase] be eased, enter, exercise (self), [phrase] follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down), [phrase] greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, [idiom] more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along), [phrase] send, speedily, spread, still, surely, [phrase] tale-bearer, [phrase] travel(-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, (way-) faring man, [idiom] be weak, whirl.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to walk (in a great variety of applications
